unsupported.recommendation: Defeat Moon Lord and the Empress of Light in your world
unsupported.reason: Boss progress is stored in the world file, not the character.

unsupported.recommendation: Buy the Peddler's Satchel for the Merchant

notes:
Version researched: Terraria 1.4.5.8 (PC). Goal: bosses (single-target damage).
Class setups: https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Guide:Class_setups (Endgame section; the guide is still being revised for 1.4.5, so 1.4.5 item pages were checked too).
Accessory slots: 7, for a Master world with the Demon Heart.
Wings: Celestial Starboard. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Celestial_Starboard
Boss buff potions are in the inventory, favorited, because quick-buff (B) only uses potions in the inventory. Exploration and utility potions are in the piggy bank. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Buffs
Convenience: Void Bag https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Void_Bag, Money Trough https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Money_Trough, Shellphone https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Shellphone, Rod of Harmony https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Rod_of_Harmony, Wormhole Potion for multiplayer https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Wormhole_Potion.
Loadout 2 is a defensive set and loadout 3 an exploring set with the same armor.
Buff stations (placed furniture) are in the safe: place them and right-click for their buff.
Best modifiers is on, so every weapon and accessory you own gets its best modifier: Legendary for melee and whips, Unreal for ranged, Mythical for magic, Fabled for summon staffs, Menacing for accessories. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Modifiers
Armor: Vortex. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Vortex_armor
S.D.M.G. with Crystal Bullets: the guide's best single-target pick for bosses. Luminite Bullets (in the safe) are its crowd pick, so swap them in for events. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Guide:Class_setups https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/S.D.M.G.
Phantasm with Ichor and Venom Arrows, and Celebration Mk2 with Mini Nukes: the guide's other single-target picks. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Guide:Class_setups
Ranger Emblem and Recon Scope (it replaces the Sniper Scope it's crafted from): ranged damage and crit for every ranged weapon. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Recon_Scope
Chaos Cylinder (1.4.5.7): +8% ranged damage for every ranged weapon and lets one weapon mix ammo types. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Chaos_Cylinder
No quiver: the Phoenix Quiver only helps bows and arrows, and the main weapon is a gun. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Phoenix_Quiver
Archery, Ammo Reservation and the Ammo Box: the guide's ranged buffs. https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Guide:Class_setups
